Question
========
Codes of conduct may be used particularly to ensure lawful processing when:

Answerlist
----------
* Data are transferred or processed for other purposes
* Data are accidently deleted
* Data are demanded by governmental authorities
* Data are collected manually


Solution
========
Codes of conduct may be used particularly to ensure lawful processing when data are transferred or processed for other purposes.

Answerlist
----------
* True
* False
* False
* False
